page.content:
Tokyo's longtime inner wholesale market, especially the tuna auctions.

How Tsukiji Market connects

  • Location: Tokyo — Tsukiji Market sat in central Tokyo as the inner wholesale market.
  • Location: Toyosu Market — Toyosu succeeded Tsukiji's inner market in 2018.
  • Topic: Edomae sushi — Edomae shops bought dawn fish at Tsukiji for generations.
  • Item: Otoro — Tsukiji's tuna auctions made otoro a public luxury.

What is Tsukiji Market?

Tsukiji's inner market supplied Edomae shops for decades. Chefs bought at dawn; tourists later crowded the tuna auction until the inner market moved.

Key threads lead to Tokyo, Toyosu Market, Edomae sushi and Otoro.
